resources.string: No AI keys connected: Horus cannot answer yet.
Horus connects several AIs in one chat, but it needs your own API keys to talk to them. Without keys it cannot answer.
The easiest start is Gemini or Groq: they are free. Open Settings, pick an AI and tap Tutorial for the steps. Paid AIs (ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek) need a prepaid balance.
Tap the model name to switch it
When two or more AIs are on, they write drafts and one gives the final answer. Uses more tokens.

Horus AI puts several AIs in one chat. Start a message with a name, for example Claude, to ask only that AI. Keys and chats stay on this device; messages go only to the AIs you turned on. The app language follows your phone language.
Add at least one API key in Settings first.
%s is turned off or has no key.
%s is a paid model and is turned off (no balance or key problem). Add credits and enter the key again.
Free AIs (Gemini, Groq) work without paying. Paid ones (ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek) need credits on the API account; a chat subscription does not count.

1. Tap Get key (aistudio.google.com/apikey).
2. Sign in with a Google account.
3. Tap Create API key.
4. Copy the key and tap Paste in Horus.
There is a free tier.

1. Tap Get key (console.groq.com/keys).
2. Sign up or sign in.
3. Tap Create API Key and give it any name.
4. Copy the key right away, it is shown once.
5. Tap Paste in Horus.
There is a free tier.

1. Open platform.openai.com and sign in.
2. In Billing add a payment method and top up the balance (usually from 5 USD).
3. Open API keys and tap Create new secret key.
4. Copy the key right away, it is shown once.
5. Tap Paste in Horus.
A ChatGPT subscription does not work as an API balance.

1. Open console.anthropic.com and sign in.
2. In Plans and Billing buy credits (usually from 5 USD).
3. Open Settings, API keys and tap Create Key.
4. Copy the key right away, it is shown once.
5. Tap Paste in Horus.
A Claude subscription does not work as an API balance.

1. Open platform.deepseek.com and sign up.
2. Top up the balance (a small amount is enough).
3. Open API keys and tap Create new API key.
4. Copy the key right away, it is shown once.
5. Tap Paste in Horus.

1. Tap Get key (cloud.cerebras.ai).
2. Sign up or sign in.
3. Open API Keys and create a key.
4. Copy the key and tap Paste in Horus.
There is a free tier.

1. Tap Get key (openrouter.ai/keys).
2. Sign up or sign in.
3. Tap Create Key.
4. Copy the key right away, it is shown once.
5. Tap Paste in Horus.
Free models have daily limits. Use Refresh model list to pick one.

1. Tap Get key (console.mistral.ai/api-keys).
2. Sign up (a phone number may be required).
3. Choose the free plan and create an API key.
4. Copy the key and tap Paste in Horus.
There is a free tier.
